symptom: An installed Candidate bundle lost its authorized root on the next wrapper invocation, and operator hosts outside product targets failed when no selected CLI was materialized.
whyGateMissed: Installation, wrapper trust injection, and host-platform fallback were tested as separate happy paths without carrying persisted Candidate trust across the boundary.
earliestDetection: Install a Candidate bundle, persist its authorized root, then invoke the generated wrapper on a host without a target CLI and require trusted bootstrap fallback.
